citations_reverified: Citations re-verified against the working tree 2026-08-25. Line numbers and quoted comment text were re-pointed after the 2026-08-24 comment humanization and the 2026-08-25 paper de-labelling; findings, verdicts and numbers are the originals and are unchanged. Scope: many quote fields and draft line references also predate the 2026-08-21 manuscript trim, which rewrote prose this pass did not re-point; where such a quote also carried an E1-E9 codename it is annotated in place rather than rewritten. Cross-references into CODE-AUDIT.md and paper/review/revision-plan.md were left alone: neither file was touched by either pass, so any drift there predates this re-verification. line_range and the per-claim line fields are left at the audit's original values as its own record of what it covered.
method: Read paper/draft.md lines 192-207 only; traced every quantitative claim to experiments/out/summary.md, experiments/out/EICU-SUMMARY.md, EICU_certificate.json, EICU_pooled.csv, EICU_diagnostics.json, out/EICU_reliability_panel.json, out-sens/, certgate/constants.py, and the read-only replay experiments/panel_s2_tables.py (stdout only; nothing written to the repo).

claims.quote: while the per-site diagnostic rises five-fold
claims.value: ~5x rise in per-site diagnostic across the s_u arm
claims.source: experiments/out/summary.md E1: su_sensitivity hard_violation_rate_diag 0.02 (s_u=0.5) -> 0.10 (s_u=1.0) -> 0.095 (s_u=2.0)
claims.note: 'Five-fold' matches hard_violation_rate_diag (0.02 -> 0.10 = 5.0x at s_u=1.0; 4.75x at s_u=2.0). The sibling diagnostic mean_per_site_exceed_frac rises only ~3x (0.055 -> 0.1634); the draft does not name which diagnostic, so the reading rests on hard_violation_rate_diag.

claims.source: experiments/out/EICU_certificate.json diagnostic.n_cal = 74, n_cal_carrying = 74; experiments/out/EICU_pooled.csv n_cal_carrying = 74 on all 40 rows; EICU-SUMMARY.md EICU-PREFLIGHT reference_check.split_projection.n_cal = 74

'~80' appears to be inherited from METHODS.md:11 (which now reads '~84 site-level observations'; the '~80' phrasing is no longer in that file). Recommend 'roughly 75' or '74'.
